## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The running status should use the same revision identifier as history so operators can match deployments across both outputs.

## Changes
The pull request adds a running status line that displays an abbreviated revision and the current attempt number. It adds tests for the status format and attempt label.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Use the history revision length in running status — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, running status displays `0123456` and history displays `0123456789ab`. The docstring promises “the same identifier as history,” but status uses `revision[:7]` and history uses `revision[:12]`. — For revisions longer than seven characters, operators cannot match the running status identifier exactly to the corresponding history entry.
